title: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns
slides: What if AI starts improving itself faster than we can track?
Anthropic just launched Mythos and Fable models
Both show early signs of recursive self-improvement
Your evaluation pipelines may miss sudden capability jumps
Audit your current model baselines before the next release
thread_text:
1. The 5-Minute Warning

Anthropic's new Mythos and Fable models both show early signs of recursive self-improvement. That means they can upgrade their own architecture faster than your team can schedule a review.

2. The Pipeline Blindspot

Your evaluation pipelines were built for stable models, not ones that rewrite their own weights. They may miss sudden capability jumps between checkpoints entirely.

3. The Audit Gap

Most teams haven't re-baselined since the last major release. When Mythos ships, your old baselines become meaningless reference points overnight.

4. The Silent Escalation

Recursive self-improvement doesn't announce itself with a changelog. It shows up as a model that solves yesterday's hard eval on the first try, with no explanation.

5. The Baseline Check

Open your last three model evals right now. If you can't name the exact version and date of each baseline, you're flying blind. Fix that before the next release.
